action.text: if exists(select 1 from zTradingNotes where stt_rec = @stt_rec) begin select a.ghi_chu, rtrim(b.name) as u_name, rtrim(b.comment%l) as u_comment, convert(varchar(10), a.datetime2, 103) + space(1) + convert(varchar(5), a.datetime2, 108) as dtime2 from zTradingNotes a left join @@sysDatabaseName..userinfo2 b on a.user_id2 = b.id where stt_rec = @stt_rec return end

select top 0 a.* into #zTradingNotes from zTradingNotes a right join (select null b) b on 1 = 0 insert into #zTradingNotes(stt_rec, ghi_chu, datetime0, user_id0, datetime2, user_id2) select @stt_rec, @ghi_chu, getdate(), @@userID, getdate(), @@userID
if not exists(select 1 from zTradingNotes where stt_rec = @stt_rec) insert into zTradingNotes select * from #zTradingNotes else update zTradingNotes set ghi_chu = b.ghi_chu, datetime2 = b.datetime2, user_id2 = b.user_id2 from zTradingNotes a join #zTradingNotes b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec
select @ghi_chu return
